description: Labelled DLI complaint examples for measuring grouping accuracy and false merges. Items are replayed in order; 'group' is the gold underlying problem. 'hardNegatives' lists group pairs that look alike but must never be merged automatically.

items.text: Our exam timetable is not out.
The LMS portal has not been loading since Monday. I cannot access my course materials or submit assignments.
My ACC 201 result for first semester 2025/2026 is not showing on the portal. Other courses are there.
We haven't received the schedule for our examinations.
The FIN 231 exam timetable contains an incorrect examination date.
There is no electricity at the Yaba study centre during weekend tutorials. We sit in the dark.
I can't log in to the e-learning portal, it keeps failing every time I try to open my course materials.
I paid my school fees through Remita two weeks ago but the payment is not reflecting on my portal.
My ACC 201 result is wrong. I scored much higher than the grade that was uploaded for first semester 2025/2026.
Examination timetable has still not been published and exams are supposed to start soon.
A staff member keeps harassing female students after evening tutorials at the study centre.
ACC 201 results for first semester 2025/2026 have not been uploaded. Please help.
It would be good if weekend tutorials were recorded and uploaded for students who work on Saturdays.
My BUS 105 result for first semester 2025/2026 is not showing on the portal.
Yaba study centre has no power on Saturdays. The generator is never switched on.
Wrong date on the FIN 231 exam timetable. It says Sunday, which cannot be correct.
The ECO 201 facilitator has not come to class for three weeks now.
The LMS is down. I am unable to open course materials or submit my assignment.
